title: Mini Mathur Wins Alliance Trophy with ₹50 Lakh Prize Money
summary: Mini Mathur won the 'Alliance' reality show, taking home the trophy and ₹50 lakh prize money. Aly Goni finished second. The show's winner was announced on [date]. Mini Mathur beat Aly Goni and Ruhee Dosani to win the top prize.
